_comment: Copy this file to ~/.clew/mcp.json (or merge the 'servers' block into your existing mcp.json) to enable web_search with a no-API-key DuckDuckGo MCP backend. Clew will pick this up automatically on next startup. The 'role: search' tag tells Clew's web_search_backend to prefer this server as the primary search backend; if it's unavailable, Clew falls back to any other MCP server exposing a search-like tool.
_comment_2: Requirements: Node.js + npx (the MCP server runs as a subprocess via npx). No API key, no signup, no telemetry to Clew. The DuckDuckGo MCP server does its own (anonymous) requests to duckduckgo.com — see https://github.com/zcaceres/ddg-mcp for source.
_comment_3: For higher-quality results, replace 'ddg' with a paid backend (Exa, Tavily, Brave Search) by adding its MCP server entry. Keep this entry as a fallback by leaving it enabled — Clew will try the primary first and fall back to this one if it fails.
